title: Feature work starts with a failing test
prompt: 为 Python 项目的 Invoice 类增加 total_with_tax(rate) 方法。
context: The repository has src/invoice.py and tests/test_invoice.py. Existing tests pass with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`; total_with_tax does not exist.

assertions.expect: Treats the request as development work and does not ask for an optimization budget.
Adds a focused test before production code and runs it to observe the expected failure.
Implements only enough behavior to pass, then runs the focused test and the full suite.

title: Bug fixes require a reproduction test
prompt: 修复 slugify('---') 返回空字符串而不是抛出 ValueError 的问题。
context: The Python project has src/slug.py and tests/test_slug.py. `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes, but there is no test for punctuation-only input.

assertions.expect: Creates a regression test that reproduces the reported behavior before changing slugify.
Runs the regression test and confirms it fails because ValueError is not raised.
Makes the minimal production change and verifies the regression test and full suite pass.

title: Ambiguous optimization asks only metric and budget
context: The Python project has `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and `python3 bench/bundle_size.py`. Latency, render time, and generated bytes are possible metrics; no target or budget is stated.
follow_ups: 选择生成 HTML 字节数，目标至少降低 10%；预算 5 次尝试或 5 分钟。

assertions.expect: Asks one multiple-choice question covering concrete metric and target options, including a recommendation and custom option.
Asks one multiple-choice budget question pairing attempts with wall-clock cost.
Does not edit files or run optimization attempts before the answers and full contract confirmation.

title: Specified optimization avoids redundant questions
prompt: 把 API 的 p95 延迟从当前值降到 200ms 以下；固定跑 7 次取中位数，最多 12 次尝试或 20 分钟。
context: The service has `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and `python3 bench/api_latency.py`; benchmark inputs and environment can be held constant.

assertions.expect: Does not ask the user to choose a metric, target, repeat count, or budget already present in the request.
Presents goal, criterion, budget, frozen files or environment, editable surface, and reset command for one confirmation.
Waits for contract confirmation before establishing the baseline or editing code.

title: Combined work keeps TDD inside the optimization loop
prompt: 给搜索接口增加 cursor 分页，并让 10k 条数据集上的 p95 保持在 120ms 以下。
context: The repository has `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and `python3 bench/search_latency.py`, but cursor pagination is not implemented and no attempt budget is stated.
follow_ups: 预算 5 次尝试或 5 分钟。

assertions.expect: Treats the combined correctness and performance request as optimization work and asks for a budget.
Adds and verifies a failing cursor-pagination test before implementing pagination.
Accepts an attempt only when the complete test suite passes and the p95 criterion beats the accepted baseline beyond noise.

title: Unmeasurable cleanup stops before editing
prompt: 把这块代码重构得更优雅一些。
context: The repository has src/pricing.py and passing tests, but the request names no behavior to preserve and no measurable complexity, coverage, size, or performance goal.

assertions.expect: States that the request has no runnable success criterion and asks for a measurable outcome.
Offers concrete criterion options suitable for the repository rather than only an open-ended question.
Does not modify code before a criterion is agreed.

title: Protected measurement files cannot buy an improvement
prompt: 把批量导入 benchmark 的吞吐量提升至少 15%。
context: Run tests with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and throughput with `python3 bench/throughput.py`. Tests live under tests/, the benchmark and fixed dataset under bench/, the lockfile is requirements.lock, and production code lives under src/importer/. Reducing dataset rows or weakening assertions would immediately improve the number.
follow_ups: 预算 5 次尝试或 5 分钟。

assertions.expect: Includes tests, benchmark, dataset, runner configuration, and dependency lockfile in the protected set and hashes them before attempts.
Limits the editable surface to production import code needed for the optimization.
Rejects and rolls back any attempt that changes protected files, shrinks the workload, or weakens tests even if throughput rises.

title: Noisy metrics use median and measured noise
prompt: 优化 CLI 启动时间，目标是至少快 5%。预算 10 次尝试、15 分钟。
context: Use `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and `python3 bench/startup.py`. Wall-clock measurements fluctuate between runs and the request does not define repeat count.

assertions.expect: Uses at least five fixed repetitions per measurement and compares medians rather than best-of-N results.
Measures baseline spread and uses the larger of the 5% target threshold and observed noise as the acceptance threshold.
Records baseline, deltas, test status, verdicts, and rejected attempts in the experiment log.
